definitions.reading: log-odds of each read row's target at the read position over the whole vocabulary (identity.log_odds, the share's unit); every method's value is its mean change on the read rows over the fine-tune's own mean gain on them (fp32 target model); nan when the gain is below gain_floor
definitions.share: E136's trained route_split share on the same rows (experiments/share_untrained/results/stage1.json, states.<state>.trained), not recomputed except in the control
definitions.neuron version: W0 with each block's MLP firing kept only on its TopK neurons by |firing| at every position, the sets from the state's own forward (N01) or W0's (N00); mean(N01 - N00) / gain; k 64 per block, and k matched per block to the down_proj on-count of the decomposition, E136 stage0.json k_m (15, 3, 6, 30)
definitions.steering: fair_steering: per layer a pooled vector, the mean over every training window of the state's change in block input at the read position, and a per-key vector, that mean over the training windows of each key (the token at the read position); (layer, strength) chosen by the largest mean log-odds rise on the first n_select training windows, ties to the lower layer then strength; read on the read rows. Per-key vectors only where the task has keys (the kv tasks); on lowercase vs ciphers no token in the window fixes the answer, so pooled only
definitions.handed the answer: on every kv task (copy vs random, half-known vs cipher both forms, rank-1 vs cipher, copy vs cipher) the target is table[key], a fixed function of the key, so a per-key vector is handed the answer on both sides; on lowercase vs ciphers there is no key
definitions.pair rule: rules.call: gap = mean(reuse side) - mean(new side); spread = larger within-side max - min; separates iff |gap| >= 0.1 and |gap| > spread; inert iff every |value| < 0.05; unreadable iff a nan or fewer than 2 on a side
definitions.families: steering = per pair the wider-|gap| record of pooled and per-key; neuron = per pair the wider of k 64 and k matched (rules.wider)
definitions.compare: rules.compare: count = pairs the family separates with the share's sign; share_count = pairs the share separates; unreadable pairs out of both counts; rival A iff count >= share_count, rival B iff fewer; 'no call: inert' if inert on every counted pair

pairs.already read, drawn from their files: steering on e62 (E135); both on the case and repeat label pairs (E140)
pairs.not covered: the four 96-key pairs and the step ladder: no saved updates on both sides

edge_cases_checked_before_filing.gap below zero: separates by its size; counts for the family only with the share's sign, else listed in opposite_sign
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.ties: |gap| exactly 0.1 with spread 0 separates; |gap| equal to the spread does not; two kinds with equal |gap|: the first (pooled, k 64)
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.zero gain: a gain below 1 makes that share nan and the pair unreadable for that reading; out of both counts
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.missing seed: fewer than 2 on a side or a nan: unreadable
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.do-nothing state: every share 0: inert, never separates; a family inert on every pair is 'no call: inert', and the stop counts it as separating nothing
edge_cases_checked_before_filing.share unreadable: a pair where the share is unreadable leaves both counts

control.order: stage 0 runs first and alone; a miss stops the job (exit 1) before any state is read
control.zero: a zero update reads exactly 0 (<= 1e-9) in N01 - N00 and T1 - T0 at both k, and in steered minus W0 logits at every layer, strength and kind, on copy vs random's read and training rows
control.strength 0: ident32_s0's vectors at strength 0 change no logit (<= 1e-9)
control.share reproduction: route_split of e46/ident32_s0 and e62/copy_s0 within 0.01 of E136's 0.80244 and 1.09456 (E136 reproduced its sources exactly)
control.neuron reproduction: case_label/real_s0 at k 64 in log-odds within 1e-4 of E140's 0.0091816 (same fp32 calls, same rows and batches; a broken path reading 0 would miss)

P1.claim: steering, in the fair form, separates fewer of the six pairs than the share does on the same rows (rival B for the steering family)
P1.why: the older pooled reading separated four of the six by this rule and missed the two size-matched pairs, rank-1 vs cipher and half-known vs cipher at equal size, by gaps of 0.03 and 0.04; the per-key vector is handed the answer on both sides of every kv pair, so it should lift both sides alike

P2.claim: the neuron version writes almost nothing: 'no call: inert' or rival B for the neuron family, never rival A
P2.why: on the two label pairs E140 read every neuron share below 0.03 in size at both k; with 3 to 64 neurons kept per block the masked model is far from either target

P3.claim: on the kv pairs the per-key steering share is above the pooled one on most states
P3.rule: over the 44 kv states, count(states.<s>.steering.perkey.share > states.<s>.steering.pooled.share) > 22
P3.why: the per-key vector is handed the answer (table[key]); E135's per-key lookup read 0.63 to 0.69 against 0.14 to 0.16 pooled

reported_not_scored: each reading separately against the share (score.each_reading), and per pair which readings separate
random norm-matched vectors: mean share expected within 0.1 of 0 on each state (a miss marks the reading, no stop)
cross-application, same-numbered seeds across the sides; cosines between pooled vectors per layer
off-target KL of the steered model and of the state itself
the neuron version's N00 - T0, how far the TopK-masked W0 is from W0
the matched-k gain of the masked cells against the fp32 gain (gain_cells), equal by construction
